explanation: This theorem just unfolds the library's own definitions. It states that `TauCeti.SpStd.groupScheme n` equals `CommHopfAlgCat.quotientSpec` applied to `TauCeti.GeneralLinear.coordinateHopfAlgebra ℤ (2(n+1))` and `definingIdeal n`, and the proof is `rw [groupScheme, definingIdeal]`. All of these constants belong to the library (TauCeti), not to Mathlib, so all of its content lies in those definitions. No Mathlib declaration could state it, and I did not need to search Mathlib.
